sources.title: Vengeance Will Be Yours · Vanguard Archive
Gulgrethor Fortress | Vanguard Saga of Heroes | Fandom

Vengeance Will Be Yours.notes: Summary is original; exact tracker and dialogue text not captured. DungeonGuru write-up reproduced by archive supplies XP, 1 silver 40 copper and no precursor. sources.title: Objects of Unknown Power · Vanguard Archive

Objects of Unknown Power.notes: Embedded Fandom account gives singular item names; main objectives say Okami Organs and Torgazu Symbols. Item spelling requires a tooltip check. Rewards, prerequisite status, exact tracker text and dialogue unknown. Next quest is Got My Eye On Something.

sources.title: Got My Eye On Something · Vanguard Archive

Got My Eye On Something.notes: Return NPC and rewards taken from embedded DungeonGuru write-up; archive warns its scraped finish field was corrupt. Direct VGOPlayers item pages establish capitalization for three pendants. Mender item stats not found. Exact objective text and dialogue unknown; source capitalization of quest title varies.

sources.title: Remnants Of The Soulless · Vanguard Archive
Gulgrethor Fortress | Vanguard Saga of Heroes | Fandom

Remnants Of The Soulless.notes: Archive lists previous Missing Agents, but wiki explicitly says it is not required for fortress quests; prerequisite left unknown. Coin field is 50 with no unit, so not converted to copper. XP and exact tracker/dialogue text unknown. Soul-on-death spawning needs manual behavior implementation. Wiki capitalization differs.

sources.title: Strong is Weak · Vanguard Archive

Strong is Weak.notes: Orb names also appear as Contagion's Orb, Miasma's Orb and Vivisector's Orb. DungeonGuru write-up gives 1 silver 60 copper and 6771 XP; archive's separate coin field is 60. Kept explicit denomination value. Use-step interaction details need review; quest must be withheld by converter.

sources.title: Sundering Wastelands · Vanguard Archive
